baseline_prompt_en: Create a photorealistic full-length environmental portrait of an original adult woman whose facial appearance follows the supplied reference image, while the character, body, wardrobe, and world remain original. She is a cloud-forest storm-keeper performing a wind-calibration operation at violet predawn in a canopy observatory grown through colossal strangler-fig roots. Seen from a three-quarter rear view, she braces her boots on a rain-dark root catwalk, turns her face naturally into view, and threads a luminous liana through a bronze tension ring to recalibrate a living storm compass. Her fully closed waxed-nettle work coat is belted over layered storm trousers, with practical gloves and high boots. Electrically charged fog advances through the canopy as the first rain bends fern vanes and agitates suspended gauge bells. Show wet fig bark, aged bronze verdigris, translucent vine tissue under tension, and one amber work lantern against cool moss glow. Keep the hand-to-vine-to-ring mechanism readable and the full working silhouette clear.
